sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Dutch-flagged polar expedition vessel at the center of the outbreak. Currently anchored off Praia, Cape Verde after Canary Islands rejected docking. 150 passengers and crew under strict precautionary isolation. Departed Ushuaia 01 April; index cases boarded with prior infection from South American birdwatching expedition.

sites.name: USHUAIA
sites.desc: Departure port. Argentine Health Ministry conducting rodent capture program & 2,500 diagnostic tests to identify outbreak source. Index cases (Dutch couple) traveled four-month route through Argentina, Chile, Uruguay before boarding.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: Remote South Atlantic island where ~30 passengers disembarked on 24 April — before outbreak was identified. Index case body removed here. Passengers have since dispersed across multiple countries.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Medical evacuation hub. Case 2 (wife of index) died on arrival 26 April. Case 3 hospitalized in ICU after evacuation from Ascension. PCR confirmation completed at NICD.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM
sites.desc: Receiving country for medical evacuations. Hospitalized flight attendant (non-passenger) under test. National contact tracing active for evacuee transport corridor.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: IHR Focal Point that issued initial WHO notification 02 May. UKHSA coordinating with Saint Helena overseas territory authorities.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on the 25 April Saint Helena → Johannesburg flight. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending lab results.

sites.name: SWITZERLAND
sites.desc: Most recent confirmed case — male passenger who left M/V Hondius voyage early and flew home before outbreak was identified. Hospitalized in isolation.

sites.name: BERLIN
sites.desc: German national among the three deceased aboard M/V Hondius. Federal contact tracing in coordination with RKI active.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: Two residents (men in 60s) self-isolating, undergoing testing. One presenting mild rhinorrhea, second asymptomatic. Communicable Diseases Agency monitoring.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating. Includes one non-passenger who shared homebound flight with confirmed case.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating. Coordinating with Public Health Agency of Canada.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: State health department monitoring symptoms of returning passenger. No symptoms reported as of latest check-in.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH monitoring returning passenger(s). Asymptomatic. Daily check-ins protocol active through end of incubation window.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring returning passenger. Asymptomatic.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring returning passengers. Asymptomatic.
